name: Debug OCI

on:
  push:
    branches: [develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [develop]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  debug-oci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:13
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: onetimesecret_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    env:
      RAILS_ENV: test
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/onetimesecret_test
      REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: actions/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.3
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: npm install -g pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
          pnpm install

      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        run: pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run database cleaner script
        run: |
          chmod +x .github/scripts/clean_databases.rb
          .github/scripts/clean_databases.rb --dry-run
          .github/scripts/clean_databases.rb

      - name: Set up database
        run: |
          bundle exec rake db:create
          bundle exec rake db:migrate
          bundle exec rake db:test:prepare

      - name: Run Ruby tests
        run: bundle exec rake test

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: pnpm run playwright

      - name: Run tryouts
        run: pnpm run test:tryouts:agent

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage/lcov.info
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
